description: REF profile for the reference client (sim/ref_client.py): the scenarios assert ourui's guarded behaviour (the v6.5-scenarios reconciliation, sim/reports/v6.5-scenarios/RECONCILE.md). The reference client is the UNGUARDED ORACLE (parity_spec word-for-word, synthetic layout, no act_guard/frame policy) and proves the sim+runner pipeline. This profile replaces the 20 reconciled expectations 1:1 with the reference client's oracle behaviour, so --ui-bin ref_client (or no --ui-bin) still runs green. Each override hits exactly one expectation (otherwise the scenario fails). The two other v6.4 overrides are not here: the grind coordinate is replaced by the layout hook (both clients implement it), and the replay_v3 timing window is fixed in the scenario itself. --no-ui-profile runs raw (against the reference client the 20 checks are then expected to fail).

idle.why: REF oracle: the reference client's synthetic layout has a page-coloured band at the top (y<44, PAGE_RGB home = (40,44,52)). ourui's gauge-arc colour (61,163,130) is the scenario default.
REF oracle: the reference client fills the circle's interior with the phase background colour (PHASE_BG READY = (24,104,92)). ourui's dark vignette background (32,36,42) is the scenario default.

fault_e1.why: REF oracle: the reference client has no act_guard — it sends brew start during an active E1, and the MCU safety-stops (sim reason 'fault E1/E2/E3'). ourui blocks the start with the toast 'FEJL AKTIV · START SPÆRRET' (the scenario default).

out_of_spec.why: REF oracle: the reference client boot-pushes out-of-spec config values straight onto the UART (no frame policy), and the sim logs range_violation. ourui rejects the whole block before sending (BLOCK≥1, the scenario default).

settings_save_matrix.why: REF oracle: PRE-INF. TIME = 5 is written parity_spec word-for-word as sub112 len2 [0x0104, 0x0505]. ourui writes sub113 len1 (stock usart_send(6,113,1), UI_v6.md §4.1) — the scenario default.
REF oracle: PRE-INF. TIME = 6 as sub112 len2 [0x0104, 0x0605] (parity word-for-word). ourui: sub113 len1 — the scenario default.
REF oracle: PAUSE TIME = 0 is an editable parameter in the reference client (sub112 len2 [0x0104, 0x0600]). In ourui PAUSE TIME is LOCKED (UI_v6.md §4.5) — the scenario default requires no write.
REF oracle: the reference client persists breakTime=0. ourui: locked, config unchanged (5) — the scenario default.
REF oracle: SAVE of break_time=0 succeeds (write+ACK+config). ourui: the hook rejects ('LOCKED') — the scenario default.
REF oracle: PAUSE TIME = 1 as sub112 len2 [0x0104, 0x0601]. ourui: locked, no write — the scenario default.
REF oracle: the reference client persists breakTime=1. ourui: locked, config unchanged (5) — the scenario default.
REF oracle: SAVE of break_time=1 succeeds. ourui: 'LOCKED' — the scenario default.
REF oracle: PAUSE TIME = 5 (the original value) as sub112 len2 [0x0104, 0x0605]. ourui: locked, no write — the scenario default.
REF oracle: SAVE of break_time=5 succeeds (the reference client does not distinguish an unchanged value). ourui: 'LOCKED' — the scenario default.

REF oracle: GRIND MODE = 1 is written parity word-for-word as sub2 len2 [1, 0] — even when the value is already saved. ourui: SAVE without a change writes nothing ('unchanged') — the scenario default.
REF oracle: the reference client does not know 'unchanged' (an addition to the contract's pending|ok|fail) and reports ok. ourui: 'unchanged' — the scenario default.
REF oracle: GRIND MODE = 2 as parity_spec's sub2 len2 [2, 0] (also sends start word 3=0). ourui deliberately writes sub2 len1 (UI_v6.md §4.1) — the scenario default.
REF oracle: the reference client allows backlight=0 (spec 0..10) and persists it. ourui deliberately omits 0 (min 1, UI_v6.md §4.3) — the scenario default requires an unchanged 9.

REF oracle: the reference client exposes init_state (a spec parameter) and persists 0. ourui: not a user setting, the hook rejects ('LOCKED', UI_v6.md §4.5) — the scenario default requires an unchanged 1.
REF oracle: the reference client exposes lang_patch and persists 0. ourui: not exposed, 'LOCKED' (UI_v6.md §4.5) — the scenario default requires an unchanged 1.
